blocks.text: STA. BARBARA, Pangasinan — Police arrested a 30-year-old man listed as the top most wanted person in the Pangasinan town of Sta Barbara for several rape cases on Tuesday (October 13). Police Colonel Michael Datuin, chief of police, said the suspect, a jobless resident of Barangay Minien West, Sta. Barbara, is also listed as top 8th most wanted person in Pangasinan.
